decisions.reason: As a publicly launched lever-handle family in the firm's core category, it fits the one-stop architectural hardware strategy and prior design/tooling investment makes management likely to continue it.

Although the mitred design may be somewhat more style-specific, it is still a visible extension of the core handle range and escalation of commitment favors giving it more time rather than withdrawing it quickly.

The multifunctional door lever handle appears somewhat narrower as a single product, but it supports the firm's barrier-free and system-solution positioning, so management would likely persist unless results were clearly poor.
This door lever handle line sits squarely in the firm's established product logic, and the sunk engineering, manufacturing and catalog commitment make near-term withdrawal unlikely.
A dedicated page and a 2023 German Design Award create strong public commitment and reputational reinforcement, making this collection especially unlikely to be taken off the market.

The light patinated bronze finish is an incremental but architecture-relevant extension of the portfolio, and because it complements existing families management is likely to retain it while attributing any weak uptake to a market adoption period.
